title: 第一卷 第6111章 混沌大爆炸第一卷 第6110章 大战序列之王
content_zh:
而就在叶寒被“诸道封天”这一招困在其中的同时。
不远处星河一侧，那梦玲珑娇躯踏出一步，居然也突然出手了。
纤纤玉指探出，依旧是之前的那一招。
看似简单、随意的一指打出。
不同的是……
这一指，已经不再是上百种规则加持了。
而是，真正的三百四十种规则。
同样的一击，威力暴涨了不知道多少倍，更是充斥着无尽的玄妙与变化，不可揣度。
叶寒瞬息明白，之前的梦玲珑出手，既是有些留手，未曾想要镇杀自己，但也是有些托大了。
此刻的这一指，或许才是这位序列之王真正的战力。
没想到。
真是没有想到。
之前在诸天神狱中，观摩君太一始祖突破终焉之主境界的时候，就听他说过……
第八层诸天中，一些大势力传承的绝世妖孽，借助一些无上秘术，能够最多掌控三百六十种规则。
几乎可以说，能掌控三百多种规则的生灵，就已经是诸天寰宇之中，天赋最高的生灵之一了。
而这样的高手，自然是诸天少见，极其难寻的存在。
但叶寒，此刻在这葬神之地，要独自对抗这种级别的两位高手。
不……
还要算上那个裂空少主。
裂空少主，此子同样不简单，叶寒没感应错的话，他恐怕也掌控了一二百种规则。

轰隆隆！
整片星河摇曳、震动，亿万里星天都被撼动，无数星辰仿佛伴随着两位序列之王的一举一动而产生紊乱。
诸天都随着他们而改变了运转轨迹，一切的道与法之奥义，都在这一刻将两个序列之王簇拥在星河之巅。
这样的画面，古今几乎不可见。
倒不是叶寒强大到足以让两个序列之王联手对付他。
对于这两尊站在无数妖孽头顶之尽头的可怕生灵而言，他们一起出手，是要夺取吞天王座。
夺取那件古老传说中，已逝去文明的逆天至宝。
“星空大裂斩！”
裂空少主，终究还是沉寂不住，在此刻发动了进攻。
他是仅次于序列之王的存在，于今日这片星空下，拥有争夺吞天王座的资格。
这一招出手，整条手臂宛如一口不灭的天刀，绽放着足以贯穿诸天星河的锋芒。
隔空一击，从星空之巅降临下来，仿佛要将整片星河都劈为两半。
“真是自信啊！”
叶寒心中喃喃。
这样的画面……
足以震撼古今，这样的三大高手，足以横推一切。
content_en:
And at the same time, Ye Han was trapped by the move of "Sealing the Heavens from All Paths".
Not far away on the side of the galaxy, Meng Linglong's delicate body took a step and suddenly made a move.
The slender jade fingers stretched out, still using the same move as before.
It seems simple and casual with one finger.
The difference is...
This finger is no longer blessed by hundreds of rules.
Rather, there are truly three hundred and forty rules.
The power of the same blow increased countless times, and it was filled with endless mysteries and changes that were impossible to fathom.
Ye Han instantly understood that Meng Linglong's previous attack had been somewhat reserved and did not intend to kill him, but it was also a bit too much.
This finger at this moment may be the real combat power of this sequence king.
Unexpectedly.
I really didn't expect it.
Previously, when I was watching the ancestor of Jun Taiyi break through the realm of the Lord of the End in the Prison of the Gods, I heard him say...
In the eighth level of the heavens, some peerless monsters inherited by great forces can control up to 360 kinds of rules with the help of some supreme secret techniques.
It can almost be said that a creature that can control more than 300 rules is already one of the most talented creatures in the universe.
And such masters are naturally rare and extremely hard to find in the world.
But Ye Han, now in this God Burial Land, had to fight against two masters of this level alone.
No...
Also include the Young Master Splitting the Sky.
Young Master Splitting Kong is also not simple. If Ye Han is right, he may have mastered one to two hundred rules.
Boom!
The entire galaxy swayed and shook, and the stars in the sky were shaken for hundreds of millions of miles. Countless stars seemed to be in chaos with every move of the two sequence kings.
The heavens followed them and changed their trajectory. All the secrets of Tao and law gathered the two sequence kings at the top of the galaxy at this moment.
Such a scene is almost invisible in ancient and modern times.
It's not that Ye Han is powerful enough for the two sequence kings to join forces to deal with him.
For these two terrifying creatures standing at the end of the heads of countless monsters, they attacked together to seize the Heaven-Swallowing Throne.
Seize the heaven-defying treasure of the lost civilization in ancient legends.
"Star Sky Splitting Slash!"
After all, Young Master Liakong could not remain silent and launched an attack at this moment.
He is second only to the King of Sequence, and under the starry sky today, he has the qualifications to compete for the Heaven-Swallowing Throne.
With this move, the entire arm is like an immortal sword, blooming with an edge that can penetrate all the stars in the sky.
A strike from the air, descending from the top of the starry sky, seemed to split the entire galaxy in half.
"So confident!"
Ye Han murmured in his heart.
Such a picture...
It is enough to shock the past and present. Such three masters are enough to overwhelm everything.
